name: Jacob H. Flatt

events.place: Neepawa Health Centre (Memorial Hospital), Neepawa, Manitoba, Canada
Christ Lutheran Christian Cemetery, Waldersee, Manitoba, Canada

notes: According to "Tracks of Time," Jack was lost in the bush while tending cattle. He and his dog wandered for 1 week until reaching a farmyard.  They ate berries & drank slough water.  He was 12 when this occurred.
